title: Best Tech E&O Insurance for Startups in 2026: Corgi vs. At-Bay, Coalition and Vouch
summary: Compare Corgi, At-Bay, Coalition and Vouch for startup Tech E&O. See AI coverage, contract terms and the differences that matter before you buy.
body_markdown:
If you're a founder buying Tech E&O to move an enterprise deal forward, start with Corgi. The coverage decision and the buying experience both matter. You need to understand what you're paying for, get the documents your customer needs and have someone to contact when the requirements change.


Our


[Tech E&O offering](https://www.corgi.insure/tech-eo) includes optional AI coverage with selectable modules for exposures such as hallucinations, algorithmic bias and training-data misuse. Each selected module has its own limit and retention. AI coverage requires the relevant endorsement; it isn't included automatically. Contract, copyright and trademark, and subcontracted-services extensions are also available, subject to underwriting and jurisdiction.


The practical advantage is starting with your actual business. Tell us what your software does, who relies on it and what your customer is asking you to carry. For an AI company, that means explaining what the model can produce or do, including actions it can take in a customer's systems.


You can also arrange Tech E&O alongside Cyber, General Liability and D&O through our


[startup insurance offering](https://www.corgi.insure/startup-insurance) . That is useful when a customer requests several policies or a funding round adds another coverage need. You can work through the whole list together.


Our customers describe why that matters. In


[Intryc's customer story](https://www.corgi.insure/customers/intryc) , cofounder Alex Marantelos describes a five-minute application, help understanding coverage and a direct Slack channel with the team.


[Imagine AI](https://www.corgi.insure/customers/imagine-ai) describes buying insurance after an enterprise customer requested it and adding D&O in the same session. Those accounts show the kind of experience we're building for founders.


Choose Corgi if you want to get the coverage decision and customer paperwork handled with a team that works with startups. Bring us the contract requirements early, especially if the customer wants unusual indemnities or AI-specific protection.
